text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, which is what the comment and tests expect.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added `DAILY_FEE` to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. I made up the author, year and copy count, since the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm the whole suite passes.
